# Oliver S. (Ozzie) Crocco

> Oliver S. Crocco, EdD, is Associate Professor of Leadership and Human Resource Development at Louisiana State University (LSU), where he is also Associate Director of the School of Leadership and Human Resource Development and PhD Program Coordinator. His research examines how people, organizations, and nations build human capability, in three streams: human capability in Southeast Asia and ASEAN, global leadership and adult learning, and the changing nature of work. He was a Visiting Professor at Chulalongkorn University in Bangkok from 2025 to 2026; that appointment has ended, and his current affiliation is LSU.

He goes by Ozzie. His surname is pronounced like the start of "crocodile." His degree is an EdD (George Washington University), not a PhD.

- [About](https://olivercrocco.com/about/): background, research streams, editorial roles, and work in the region
- [Contact](https://olivercrocco.com/contact/)

## Work

- [Books](https://olivercrocco.com/books/): authored, co-authored, and edited books with Palgrave Macmillan, Cambridge University Press, and Edward Elgar
- [Selected publications](https://olivercrocco.com/publications/): articles and chapters by research stream
- [Notes](https://olivercrocco.com/notes/): essays and reflections

## Tools and projects

- [Tools](https://olivercrocco.com/tools/): free research utilities, including the Reviewer Finder and an inter-rater reliability calculator
- [Reentry Toolkit](https://olivercrocco.com/reentry/): free tools for people returning to work after incarceration
- [Poetry of Work](https://olivercrocco.com/poetry/): public-domain poems about work paired with photographs
